summary: The pin is wrong three times over and no chapter-number anchor is honest on this row. (1) WRONG WORK: MU's Cobra entry writes its coverage as labelled segments — anime.start 'Adapts elements from Vol 1-3 (Movie) / Vol 1, Chap 1 (1983) / Adapts the Black Bullet plot of Chap 15, Chap 17, 19, 21-22 (2010)', anime.end 'Vol 8, Chap 14 (1983)'. Our stored ep-13 anchor (14, vol 8) is the (1983) SEGMENT, i.e. the endpoint of the FIRST TV series スペースコブラ (31 eps, 1982-10 to 1983-05): ja-WP's 沿革 says Part 1 'through the Salamander (Sid's Goddess) arc' is what was animated in 1982-83, and MangaDex's unit 14 is titled 'The Goddess Sid' in volume 8 — JC vol 8 is 「シドの女神の巻」. MU never states an END for the 2010 series at all; its only 2010 statement is in the START field. (2) WRONG SPACE: 14 is not in our stored 156-chapter space either. MU's and MangaDex's numbering is a 28-unit STORY numbering over the 18 volumes (ch 1 'The Revival of Cobra' = vol 1 … ch 28 'Cobra Returns' = vol 18), which is why MU's latest_chapter is 28 while AniList says 156 — that is flag #701, and the answer is that neither source is lying: 156 is the per-instalment 話 numbering of the Weekly Shonen Jump run (jajanken's MADB-derived table has exactly 156 rows, 1978年45号 → 1984年48号; ja-WP's infobox 157話 = those 156 plus the vol-18 draw-down short リターンコブラ = MangaDex unit 28). (3) ANOTHER WORK ENTIRELY: ep 13 遥かなる記憶 is the fourth and last episode of the ギャラクシー・ナイツ block (eps 10-13) — ja-WP's 各話リスト carries a 原作エピソード column whose rowspan-4 cell over eps 10-13 reads ギャラクシー・ナイツ, its prose says the TV series was made from 「1982年に描かれた中編5作品と1996年に描かれた「ギャラクシーナイツ」編」, and MU's separate entry for the full-colour series says in so many words 'EP 10-13 adapt the fully new Vol 4 (2010)'. Galaxy Knights ran in スーパージャンプ in 1996 (6 instalments) and was collected as vol 4 of the full-colour 『SPACE ADVENTURE COBRA』 JCデラックス — it is NOT part of the 1978-84 serialization our source entry (AniList 31062: 156 chapters, 18 volumes, 1978-1984) numbers. So ep 13 is anchor_hostile under A44 (another chapter space), stays canon, and carries a side_source annotation naming the work; the stored 14/vol 8 is deleted. No continue is delivered: this entry adapts five self-contained mid-run stories plus a 1996 side work, out of order and with at least one of them (「カゲロウ山」登り, eps 6-7) first published outside Weekly Shonen Jump (フレッシュジャンプ 1983年4月号), so the furthest first-time position in the source's own numbering cannot be pinned from any published source and a C5 'coverage + 1' would be a guess.

anchor_hostile.why: A44 — ANOTHER CHAPTER SPACE (the Trigun Maximum shape). Ep 13 遥かなる記憶 (2010-03-27) closes the ギャラクシー・ナイツ block: ja-WP's 各話リスト gives 原作エピソード = ギャラクシー・ナイツ as a rowspan-4 cell covering eps 10-13, its prose states the TV series was made 「1982年に描かれた中編5作品と1996年に描かれた「ギャラクシーナイツ」編を原作として」, and MangaUpdates' entry for the full-colour series (Cobra: The Space Pirate, 15 vols) writes 'EP 10-13 adapt the fully new Vol 4 (2010)' — vol 4 of that series is 「ギャラクシー・ナイツ」 (JCデラックス full-colour, 1996年9月発行). Galaxy Knights is a 1996 スーパージャンプ work of 6 instalments (COBRA the information's serialization table: 'ギャラクシーナイツ(6話分) 1996年'), collected as its own volume and reissued as vol 14 of KADOKAWA's 16-volume 廉価版 — it has no number in the 156-instalment 1978-84 Weekly Shonen Jump space our source entry (AniList 31062, 18 vols, 1978-1984) counts, and it is a separate series entry on both MU (1281590513) and MangaDex. The row stays CANON (it is a faithful adaptation of a licensed Terasawa Cobra work; ja-WP: 「原作をほぼ忠実に再現している」) and takes a side_source annotation instead of a number. Content check, Bandai Channel's own per-episode synopsis: King recovers his memory that he is シバ大王, believes the man with the gun in his left arm who killed his wife is Cobra, and challenges him — the Galaxy Knights climax, not any WSJ chapter.

annotations.chapters: COBRA ギャラクシー・ナイツ (Galaxy Knights) — スーパージャンプ 1996, 6 instalments; collected as 『SPACE ADVENTURE COBRA』 JCデラックス full-colour vol 4 (1996-09) and as vol 14 of KADOKAWA's 16-volume 廉価版 『COBRA THE SPACE PIRATE』
annotations.note: T26 side_source: the row adapts a DIFFERENT licensed Terasawa work from the series' identified source (the 1978-84 Weekly Shonen Jump コブラ, 18 vols / 156 instalments, AniList 31062). Side_source rows carry no chapter mapping by design (A1/A44). The same annotation belongs on eps 10, 11 and 12 — the whole Galaxy Knights block — but those rows are outside this task's scope; see flags.

ja-WP on the TV series: 「原作をほぼ忠実に再現しているが、アニメオリジナルシーンもある」 and its footnote names exactly two — ep 1's scene of Cobra calling Lady en route to Garon, and 最終話のエピローグ, the FINALE'S EPILOGUE. So ep 13 is a faithful close of Galaxy Knights plus an anime-original epilogue; it is not a filler row and not a studio ending.

repairs.why: G37 / G32 gate 0 — the stored value is another WORK'S segment in another EDITION'S numbering, on a row that adapts a third work. MU's Cobra entry (45832626190) writes anime.end = 'Vol 8, Chap 14 (1983)' — ONE segment, labelled with a year 27 years outside this entry's broadcast window (2010-01-02 → 2010-03-27), so pickEntrySegments' `segments.length <= 1` short-circuit takes it unexamined. '(1983)' is the FIRST TV series, スペースコブラ (Tokyo Movie Shinsha, 31 eps, 1982-10 → 1983-05): ja-WP's 沿革 states 第1部 (連載開始 through 「サラマンダー（シドの女神）」編) 「ここまでのエピソードが『スペースコブラ』としてTVアニメ化（1982 - 1983年）」, and both MU's and MangaDex's unit 14 is 'The Goddess Sid' in volume 8 = JC vol 8 「シドの女神の巻」 — the exact end of Part 1. MU states NOTHING about this entry's endpoint; its only 2010 sentence is in anime.start ('Adapts the Black Bullet plot of Chap 15, Chap 17, 19, 21-22 (2010)') and on its sister entry ('EP 10-13 adapt the fully new Vol 4 (2010)'). Beyond the wrong work, the number is in the wrong space: 14 is a unit in MU/MangaDex's 28-unit STORY numbering (1 'The Revival of Cobra' vol 1 … 28 'Cobra Returns' vol 18), not in the 156-instalment space our catalog stores. And ep 13 adapts the 1996 Galaxy Knights, which has no number in either. No corrected value exists — the anchor should be deleted, not moved (A44).

Follows the end_chapter deletion — vol 8 (「シドの女神の巻」, 1981-05-15) is where the 1982-83 TV series stopped, not anything ep 13 touches. If a volume-level instrument is ever wanted for eps 10-13, the honest one is vol 14 of KADOKAWA's 16-volume 廉価版 『COBRA THE SPACE PIRATE』 (「ギャラクシー・ナイツ」, 2008-11-22) — a franchise-continuous edition MU itself lists in this series' status field — never vol 8 of the 18-volume Jump Comics run.

structure.notes:
ROW IDENTITY: our 13 rows are COBRA THE ANIMATION, the 2010 TV series (AniList 5032, Magic Bus, BS11 土曜23:30 ANIME+, 2010-01-02 → 2010-03-27). Row 13's stored title 'Distant Memories' and date 2010-03-27 match ja-WP's 各話リスト (第13話(最終話)「遥かなる記憶」, 3月27日) — no identity repair. Sibling entries NOT in this row set: スペースコブラ TV第1作 (31 eps, 1982-83, Tokyo Movie Shinsha); the 1982 film; COBRA THE ANIMATION ザ・サイコガン OVA (4 vols, 2008-09); COBRA THE ANIMATION タイム・ドライブ OVA (2 vols, 2009, AniList 5031, our entry's PREQUEL edge).

THREE CHAPTER SPACES, and flag #701's answer. (a) OUR stored space, total_chapters=156: the per-instalment 話 numbering of the Weekly Shonen Jump serialization, 1978年45号 → 1984年48号. jajanken.net's table (built from 文化庁 メディア芸術データベース and supplemented) has exactly 156 numbered rows and its header reads 話数: 全156話 — #1 1978年45号「復活!コブラの巻」 … #156 1984年48号「生と死の狭間に の巻」. ja-WP's infobox says 157話, citing the COBRA大解剖 mook; the difference is the vol-18 draw-down short リターンコブラ, which never ran in a magazine (it is MangaDex unit 28 'Cobra Returns'). (b) MU's and MangaDex's space, 28 units over 18 volumes: a STORY-level numbering used by the scanlations (HappyScans! / Hokuto no Gun) — ch 1 = vol 1, 4-7 = vol 4, 14 = vol 8 'The Goddess Sid', 16/16.4 = 異次元レース across vols 10-11, 17 = 'The Golden Door' vol 11, 19-21 = vol 13, 22-23 = vol 14, 27-28 = vol 18. MU's latest_chapter 28 is this, not a ceiling in our space, and MangaDex links al=31062 — the same AniList work in a different numbering. (c) VOLUME-level editions, all incompatible with each other: JC 18 vols (1979-85), JC Deluxe 10, 創美社愛蔵版 12, 集英社文庫 12, MF完全版 12, MF廉価版 16, MF 8-vol reissue — and the 16-volume 廉価版 is FRANCHISE-CONTINUOUS (vols 1-12 = the Jump run + 聖なる騎士伝説, 13 = タイム・ドライブ, 14 = ギャラクシー・ナイツ, 15 = ザ・サイコガン, 16 = マジックドール). buichi.com's own 12-volume list is yet another partition and does not match ja-WP's 完全版 list — do not join any Cobra position on a volume number without naming the edition.

WHAT THIS ENTRY ADAPTS (ja-WP 各話リスト 原作エピソード column, per-row): eps 1-4 黄金の扉 | ep 5 さまよえる美女の伝説 | eps 6-7 「カゲロウ山」登り | ep 8 マンドラド | ep 9 黒い弾丸 | eps 10-13 ギャラクシー・ナイツ. Six stories, selected and RE-ORDERED out of the middle of a 6-year run, and they do not all live in one space: 黒い弾丸 is the 巨弾読切 of WSJ 1981年23号 = instalment #83 of 156 (jajanken row 83 is tagged 読切 with that issue; COBRA the information's summary names it '(巨弾読切)1981年23号(黒い弾丸)'), i.e. ep 9 jumps BACKWARDS behind eps 1-4 (黄金の扉 opens Part 4 at #95 1982年25号「シバの鍵の秘密の巻」 — the source of ep 1's title シバの鍵); 「カゲロウ山」登り first ran in フレッシュジャンプ 1983年4月号, NOT in Weekly Shonen Jump, so eps 6-7 have no number in the 156 space at all; and eps 10-13 are the 1996 Super Jump Galaxy Knights. MU's own two sentences agree with this shape from the other side: 'Adapts the Black Bullet plot of Chap 15, Chap 17, 19, 21-22 (2010)' on the Jump entry and 'Adapts redrawn stories from Vol 3, 7, 10 & 13, EP 10-13 adapt the fully new Vol 4 (2010)' on the full-colour entry.

WHY NO CONTINUE (and no honest terminal number): under A4 the honest terminal would be the furthest first-time MAINLINE instalment this entry reaches. The story→instalment boundaries inside Part 4 (話 95-116) are not published by any source I could find — jajanken gives per-issue 〜の巻 subtitles, not story names, and the volume-lead titles of JC 11-13 do not partition them — and at least one, possibly three, of the animated 中編 (カゲロウ山登り certainly; マンドラド and さまよえる美女の伝説 plausibly, given JC vol 13's 1983-07 release and buichi.com's own volume summaries) ran outside WSJ. So a C5 'coverage + 1' would be a fabricated number, and even a correct one would mislead: this entry leaves 話 1-82 and 84-94 completely unadapted as well. The honest reader instruction is arc-level (see flags), not a chapter.

flags_for_sean: LIB GAP (G32 gate 0, scripts/ingest/lib/mu-coverage.ts): a SINGLE labelled segment is never tested. pickEntrySegments returns early on `segments.length <= 1` with reason 'single segment', so MU's anime.end 'Vol 8, Chap 14 (1983)' is taken whole on a 2010 entry even though segmentIsEntry would have returned FALSE for it (a year outside the broadcast window ±1 is the code's own 'another work' rule). Suggested gate: run segmentIsEntry on the single segment too — a decisive FALSE should refuse and list (mu_pin_multiwork_unresolved), never pin. cobra-the-animation is the witness; every one-segment MU string whose label names a different adaptation has this shape. Related: MU's 2010 information lives entirely in anime.START on two different series entries, which the frontier never reads.

FLAG #701 ANSWERED (count_mismatch, AniList 156 vs MU 28): not an edition mix in the toriko/gto sense — two numberings of the SAME work. 156 = the WSJ per-instalment 話 numbering (jajanken/MADB; ja-WP's 157 = +リターンコブラ). 28 = MU's and MangaDex's story-unit numbering over the 18 volumes. Our stored 156 is the right ceiling for the source; the flag can close with that note. NOTE for the writer: any future MU-derived Cobra pin arrives in the 28-space and must NOT be written into the 156-space.

ARC-LEVEL TREATMENT PROPOSED (the ask's option 3). COBRA THE ANIMATION is not a linear adaptation and no per-episode chapter instrument is honest for it: six self-contained stories, taken out of order, from three different magazines (WSJ 1981 一発読切, WSJ 1982 Part 4, フレッシュジャンプ 1983, スーパージャンプ 1996). The reader-facing truth is 'this anime animates six Cobra stories; nothing about your reading position follows from having watched it'. If the catalog wants positions here, the instrument would be story/volume level in a NAMED edition (the 16-volume 廉価版 is the only edition that contains all six: 黄金の扉 = vol 7, 神の瞳 = vol 8 region, マンドラド/さまよえる美女 in the Jump vols, ギャラクシー・ナイツ = vol 14) — a series-level ruling, not something research can force into end_chapter.

SCOPE NOTE: the side_source annotation belongs on eps 10, 11 and 12 as well (ja-WP's rowspan-4 原作エピソード cell and MU's 'EP 10-13' both cover the whole block), and those three rows are stored canon with no anchors, so nothing contradicts them today. I did not write them because the task scopes to ep 13. Eps 6-7 (「カゲロウ山」登り, フレッシュジャンプ 1983年4月号) are a second, smaller case of the same kind — material outside the 156-instalment space — and would need their own check before anything is stored on them.

UNRESOLVED, stated rather than guessed: which WSJ instalments (話) each of the five 中編 occupies. jajanken's table gives 話 95-115 for Part 4 (1982年25号-45号) plus a 読切 at #116 (1982年52号, title not recorded), but no source I found partitions those instalments into 黄金の扉 / 神の瞳 / マンドラド / 黄金とダイヤ / さまよえる美女の伝説. 文化庁's メディア芸術データベース (mediaarts-db.bunka.go.jp), which jajanken cites as its source, was unreachable from here (TLS failure) — a per-issue lookup there would settle both this and ep 9's 話 83. cobra.fandom.com returns HTTP 410 (the wiki is gone), so there is no episode-level fandom source for this series.
